# Guild

> Independent checks for the AI you ship, and free guides for founders.

## Guides

- [Payment webhook checklist for Razorpay and Stripe (Next.js)](https://www.guilds.work/guides/payment-webhook-checklist-razorpay-stripe): Six manual checks for a payment webhook, each linked to the official docs.
- [CERT-In AI Security Auditing Guidelines (2026), explained for startups](https://www.guilds.work/guides/cert-in-ai-security-auditing-guidelines): Who the guideline covers, how the four risk tiers work, and a 30-day plan.
